hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || true
cat >/dev/null || true; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'

cat >/dev/null || true; R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$R" ] || exit 0; if [ "$(git -C "$R" config core.hooksPath 2>/dev/null)" != ".githooks" ] && [ -d "$R/.githooks" ]; then   git -C "$R" config core.hooksPath .githooks && chmod +x "$R/.githooks/pre-commit" 2>/dev/null;   echo "guardrails: installed core.hooksPath=.githooks"; fi; exit 0
